add table inet fvpn
flush set inet fvpn allowed_v4
add element inet fvpn allowed_v4 { 100.64.1.1 timeout 3599872ms, 100.64.1.2 timeout 3599872ms, 100.64.2.1 timeout 3599872ms }
flush set inet fvpn denied_v4
